meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成一个定制助手:你先说想加什么功能或改什么行为,它会先问几个问题弄清需求,再添加新渠道、改触发规则、接集成等,完成后告诉你怎么验证。
howto.when: 当你提出要添加渠道(如 Telegram、Slack、邮件等)、修改触发规则,或做其他任何自定义改动时触发;它会先提问了解具体需求。

say.text: 我想把 Telegram 加为输入通道。
say.note: 它会先问接到哪个代理组,再执行安装。

say.text: 帮我改一下触发规则,让某些消息不唤醒机器人。
say.note: 它会更新对应连接的触发条件,并告诉你怎么测试。

say.text: 给某个代理组加上日历集成。
say.note: 它会优先找专用技能,否则指导配置 MCP 服务器。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a customization assistant: it first asks clarifying questions, then adds channels (e.g., Telegram, Slack), adjusts trigger rules, or makes other changes, and finally explains how to verify.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to add a channel (e.g., Telegram, Slack, email), change trigger rules, or make any other customization. It starts by asking clarifying questions.

say_en.text: I'd like to add Telegram as an input channel.
say_en.note: It will ask which agent group to connect, then install.

say_en.text: Change the trigger rules so certain messages don't wake the bot.
say_en.note: It updates the wiring triggers and tells you how to test.

say_en.text: Add a calendar integration to one of the agent groups.
say_en.note: It checks for a dedicated skill, else guides MCP setup.
